scholarships.title: AAPG - Appel à projets générique 2027 (ANR Generic Call for Proposals 2027)

eligibility: Open to all scientific communities and to all public or private actors involved in French research
Covers all scientific fields and all disciplines, including fundamental, exploratory and finalised research

Structured into 57 research axes, each corresponding to a scientific evaluation committee (CES) of the same name: 38 axes within 7 disciplinary domains and 19 axes on cross-cutting trans- or interdisciplinary issues
Coordinators choose the funding instrument (JCJC, PRME, PRC, PRCE, PRCI) when submitting or registering the project; this choice cannot be changed during the selection process
For the PRCE instrument in step 1, no scientific document is required: only the online project characterisation form and the CVs of coordinators and partner scientific leads must be completed

For PRCI collaborations, only the PRCI annexes confirm whether the collaboration is open and under which submission modality; mandatory step 1 registration applies in ANR Lead Agency and non-Lead Agency modalities
existing.eligibility_summary: All scientific communities and all public or private actors involved in French research may apply through one of five funding instruments, choosing one of 57 research axes.
benefits: Project-based research funding awarded through the JCJC, PRME, PRC, PRCE and PRCI instruments, which can include recruitment of doctoral contracts
coverage: Project-based research funding awarded through the JCJC, PRME, PRC, PRCE and PRCI instruments, which can include recruitment of doctoral contracts
requirements: Step 1 submission and registration must be completed on the IRIS portal before 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST
The research axis, and therefore the scientific evaluation committee, must be chosen at submission and cannot be modified during the selection process
For step 2 invitations, the project must be complete on the submission site by the step 1 closing date and time
For automatic step 2 reinvitation of AAPG 2026 complementary-list projects: same coordinator, same funding instrument, same title and a comparable consortium
The ANR-NSF PRCI collaboration may not be confirmed before the end of step 1 submission and registration; applicants must factor this into their submission strategy
The ANR-FRQ (Franco-Quebec) PRCI collaboration is suspended for the 2027 edition
documents: AAPG 2027: Texte de l'appel à projets (anr-aapg-2027.pdf)
Annexe budgétaire spécifique aux partenaires français - obligatoire pour les collaborations en Lead étranger
Relevant PRCI bilateral collaboration annexes (DFG, FWF, CNPq, FACEPE, FAPESP, RGC, FNR, NRF, FNS, NSTC)
application_method: Choose the funding instrument and the research axis (and therefore the CES) that matches the project objectives
For PRCE in step 1, complete only the online project characterisation form and the CVs online
For PRCI, consult the dedicated bilateral collaboration annex to confirm the collaboration is open, its modality and its themes
For JCJC, PRME, PRC (and PRCE from step 2), submit the pre-proposal using the published template on the IRIS portal (https://iris.anr.fr/fr/login)
For PRCI submissions where a partner agency is Lead Agency, submit a copy of the project to that foreign agency within the timetable set in the dedicated annex
Complete submission and registration before 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST
existing.selection_notes: Coordinators choose the research axis and thus the scientific evaluation committee at submission; the choice cannot be changed during the selection process. PRCE step 1 registrations that meet the step 1 eligibility criteria receive an automatic invitation to step 2 without assessment of the scientific value of the registration by the scientific evaluation committees. Step 1 results are notified to coordinators mid-February 2027; a right of reply to reviews opens on IRIS in week 20 of May 2027; the list of projects selected for funding is published in July 2027. PRCI selection requires joint agreement of both funding agencies, each of which ultimately funds the teams of its own country.
existing.best_fit: Principal investigators and research teams based in a French institution who can submit a project through the IRIS portal by the step 1 deadline and who intend to recruit doctoral students as part of the funded project.
existing.notes: This is a research-project funding call, not an individual scholarship: there is no personal application route and no scholarship awarded directly to a student. A doctoral contract arises only when a selected project recruits a doctoral student. Funding amounts per instrument are not stated on the call page and must be read in the AAPG 2027 call text (anr-aapg-2027.pdf) and the ANR financial regulations; they are deliberately left unstated here. Projects ranked on the AAPG 2026 complementary list may have to change their partnership to meet the new PRC criteria for the 2027 edition. Applicants selected for funding at the 2026 edition must cancel their AAPG 2027 PRCI registration or JCJC/PRME/PRC submission or PRCE registration by email to aapg.science@anr.fr.
existing.duration: Project duration set by the applicant; grants are awarded annually across the project period
existing.application_period: Call opened 16 July 2026 at 09:00 CEST. Step 1 submission and registration closes 13 October 2026 at 17:00 Paris time. Step 1 results are notified mid-February 2027; step 2 runs from end February 2027 (template and IRIS opening) with submission closing end March 2027; selected projects are announced July 2027.
